note: Port Calder and its walks are fictional. These are the app's fixed facts: a redesign keeps every name, distance, duration, stop and access note as written.

walks.name: Harbour Lights
walks.summary: Lamp-lit quays, the fish market's arches and the old customs house.

stops.name: Ferry Steps
stops.note: The walk starts where the island ferry ties up.

stops.name: Fish Market Arches
stops.note: Seven brick arches; the market opens at six.

stops.name: Customs House
stops.note: Its clock still runs ten minutes fast.

stops.name: Rope Walk
stops.note: A quarter-mile shed where ships' ropes were twisted.

stops.name: Harbour Light
stops.note: The red lamp at the end of the east pier.

stops.name: Net Menders' Yard
stops.note: Benches and the best view back over the quays.

walks.name: Market Stairs
walks.summary: Stone stairs between the covered market and the bell tower lookout.

stops.name: Hay Market
stops.note: The covered market, busiest before noon.

stops.name: Cooper's Stair
stops.note: One hundred and twelve steps; a handrail on the left.

stops.name: Printers' Court
stops.note: A courtyard of old presses, open to walk through.

stops.name: Bell Tower
stops.note: The lookout is open until dusk.

stops.name: Wall Walk
stops.note: A stretch of the old town wall above the rooftops.

walks.name: Canal Loop
walks.summary: Towpaths past the dye works, two lock gates and the printers' lane.

stops.name: Mill Bridge
stops.note: Cast-iron, with the mill's name still on the rail.

stops.name: Dye Works
stops.note: The water ran blue here on Mondays.

stops.name: Upper Lock
stops.note: The lock keeper's cottage is a café now.

stops.name: Weavers' Row
stops.note: Tall windows let the light onto the looms.

stops.name: Lower Lock
stops.note: Watch the gates open on the hour.

stops.name: Basin
stops.note: Moored boats and a chalkboard of the day's arrivals.

stops.name: Printers' Lane
stops.note: The loop closes back at Mill Bridge.

walks.name: Garden Hill
walks.summary: Terraced allotments, the glasshouse and a view over the whole bay.

stops.name: Orchard Gate
stops.note: Apple trees planted by the first allotment holders.

stops.name: Terraces
stops.note: Grassy steps between the plots; uneven after rain.

stops.name: Glasshouse
stops.note: Warm all year, with a palm older than the town hall.

stops.name: Beehives
stops.note: Keep to the path while the bees are out.

stops.name: Signal Station
stops.note: Flags once told the harbour which ships were coming.

stops.name: Bay View
stops.note: The whole of Port Calder from one bench.
